problem: Two changes, and nothing else in this file. (1) Bug seen in the running app: on a fresh load of /notifications?id=<id>, with <id> on the current page and rows that have descriptions, the notification shows in the highlighted block and again in the table. `NotificationDescription` is lazy, so on first load a row suspends the boundary above the table, material-table's componentDidUpdate does not run while the table is hidden, and its state keeps the old rows. Fix: remove the `<Suspense fallback={null}>` that wraps the highlighted block in the returned JSX, keeping the `aria-current` div and its contents as they are, and instead wrap `<NotificationDescription description={notification.payload.description} />` in `<Suspense fallback={null}>` inside `renderNotificationContent`, so neither the block nor a row can suspend the table. Keep the `Suspense` import. (2) When the highlighted notification is the only row, do not show 'No records to display' under the block. `notifications` arrives with the highlighted row already removed, so empty `notifications` alone does not mean that: a filter that really returned nothing must still show the message. `totalCount` is the unfiltered count. In the Table's `localization.body`, set `emptyDataSourceMessage` to an empty string when `Boolean(highlightedNotification) && notifications.length === 0 && (totalCount ?? 0) > 0`, and to `t('table.emptyMessage')` otherwise. With no `highlightedNotification`, output and behaviour stay exactly as they are.

Add one sentence after the table of widgets that holds the 'Unread notifications' row at line 123: to place this widget in the default layout, use its name, `HomePageUnreadNotifications`, as the value of `component` in `page:home.defaultConfig`. Keep the existing extension id `home-page-widget:notifications/unread-notifications` in that row exactly as it is, and change nothing else in the file.

Add two tests to this file. The six existing tests pass and stay exactly as they are. Use the file's `createNotification` fixture, which sets a description, and the same TestApiProvider `apis` as the other tests, including `[toastApiRef, { post: jest.fn() }]`. (1) 'shows a row of the current page only in the highlight': `getNotifications` resolves `{ notifications: [first, second], totalCount: 2 }`, `getNotification` resolves `first`, and the route is `/?id=<first's id>`. Assert `const occurrences = await screen.findAllByText(<first's title>)`, then `expect(occurrences).toHaveLength(1)`, that `occurrences[0].closest('[aria-current="true"]')` is in the document, and that `await screen.findByText(<second's title>)` is in the document and its `closest('[aria-current="true"]')` is null. (2) 'hides the empty message only when the highlight is the only row': first render with `getNotifications` resolving `{ notifications: [item], totalCount: 1 }`, `getNotification` resolving `item` and the route `/?id=<item's id>`; after `await screen.findByText(<item's title>)`, assert `screen.queryByText('No records to display')` is null, then unmount. Then render with `getNotifications` resolving `{ notifications: [], totalCount: 0 }`, `getNotification` resolving a read notification from `createNotification('read-1', 'Read notification', true)` and the route `/?id=read-1`; assert `await screen.findByText('No records to display')` is in the document and `screen.getByText('Read notification')` is in the document. Do not change NotificationsPage.tsx or NotificationsTable.tsx.
